January 17th 1930.

Further Report re-Alleged Communist in
Sing Ming (新民) College, No.80 Connaught Road.

Sir,

Reference to the attached, Mr. Lee Fung Ding (李鳳亭),
Dean of the Sing Ming University (新民大學), No. 80 Connaught
Road, interviewed, stated that the student Lee Sang Shu (李尚儒),
who made allegation against him in connection with the
communist literature found concealed in the Sing Ming University
absconded on the night of December 25, 1929, the very day
he brought him back to school for question. Mr. Lee Fung
Ding further stated that he has made inquiries and is of the
opinion that the literature which found in the school, was
put there by Lee Sang Shu. Since the departure from the
school of Lee Sang Shu no further untoward incident has
occurred in the school. Inquiries made by us among
students in the school failed to discover the origin of the
literature mentioned.

（左侧批注：Literature more "leftist" than communistic YR）
（左侧批注：HR）

Officer i/c Special Branch.

關於康納路80號新民學院涉嫌共產黨人之進一步報告。

鈞座：

參閱附件，康納路80號新民大學校長李鳳亭先生接受問詢時稱，該校學生李尚儒曾就於新民大學內發現藏匿的共產主義文獻一事對其提出指控，該生已於1929年12月25日晚間潛逃，當日正是將其帶回學校接受質詢之日。李鳳亭先生進一步表示，經其調查，認為在學校發現的文獻係由李尚儒放置。自李尚儒離校後，校內未再發生其他不良事件。我方在該校學生中進行的調查未能查明上述文獻的來源。

December 30, 1929.

Further Report re-Alleged Communists in
Sing Ming (聖瑪) College, No.80 Connaught Road.

Sir,

Reference to the attached, General Chang Yao Ching
(張卿), an ex-Tuchun of Kiangsu, who lives in Hardoon Road,
and who is interested in the welfare of the Sing Ling College,
came to our Intelligence Office, on December 4, to see Mr. Tan
Shao-liang CA in respect of inquiries that had been made by the
Loong Hwa Military Authorities as result of an anonymous report
they had received about Communists in the College. General Chang
stated that this report had been found to be false, and that
it had been apparently made out of revenge against the Dean of
the College who had been responsible for frustration of a plot
among certain of the students to misappropriate some $20,000,
funds of the college.

Mr. Tan Shao-liang, who at this time did not know that
we were making inquiries in respect of reports of Communists in
this college, referred General Chang to C.D.I. Robertson, who
after hearing what the General had to say, asked that the Dean
be brought up for inquiries.

On Dec. ber 23, General Chang and the Dean, Lee Fung
Ding (李鳳亭), came up to our Intelligence Office, and at that
time Lee Zang Shu (李尚儒), was in our office reporting that the
time was opportune for us to go and search the Dean's rooms in
the College, as he which he had seen a parcel of Communistic literature
there. From this man's attitude under interrogation, and
his anxiety to have the Dean's quarters searched, and the Dean
arrested at that time, and from what we had learned from General
Chang, and the Dean himself, we were of the opinion that there was
something extraordinary behind Lee Zang Shu's reports and decided
on the action we took, which resulted in confirmation of our
opinion, as Lee Zang Shu then told us that the literature he had

1929年12月30日。

關於康納路80號聖瑪學院涉嫌共產黨人之進一步報告。

鈞座：

參閱附件，前江蘇督軍張卿將軍，現居哈同路，並關心聖靈學院之福祉，於12月4日前來本處情報科拜訪譚紹良高級探員，以回應龍華軍事當局因收到關於該學院有共產黨人的匿名舉報而進行的查詢。張將軍表示，該舉報已被證實為虛假，且顯係出於報復，針對的是該院校長，因為校長挫敗了部分學生侵吞約20,000元校款的陰謀。

譚紹良先生當時並不知曉我方正在就該學院有共產黨人的報告進行調查，遂將張將軍引薦給刑事偵緝處處長羅伯遜（Robertson）。羅伯遜聽取將軍陳述後，要求傳喚校長前來接受問詢。

12月23日，張將軍與校長李鳳亭來到本處情報科，當時李尚儒亦在我們辦公室，聲稱時機已到，建議我們前往搜查校長在校內的房間，因他曾在該處看到一包共產主義文獻。從該人在受審時的態度、其急切希望搜查校長住所並立即逮捕校長的表現，以及我們從張將軍和校長本人處獲悉的情況來看，我們認為李尚儒的舉報背後另有隱情，並決定採取相應行動，結果證實了我們的判斷，因為李尚儒隨後告訴我們，他在

pages.en:
File No.
(C.I.D.) Office Notes
2
seen in the Dean's room had been put there by some of the
students, but he refused to disclose their names. General
Chang and the Dean heard this statement and when they went
back to the College the parcel of literature was found as Lee
Zang Shu stated, and they brought it to our office the next
day, December 14, thinking no doubt that it was the correct thing
to do. It seemed quite evident that Lee Zang Shu was a party
to the plot against the Dean, who informed us that he had
recently noticed something strange in the movements of Lee
Zang Shu, who had been first in the school in the morning and
last to leave at night, which was unusual, and would give him
opportunity to enter rooms where he had no legitimate business
and probably put the literature where it was found himself,
although he did not blame him altogether.
Unless information had leaked out from Gordon Road
Station, or the Court, the Dean could not know that we had
the case in hand or had a Search Warrant, and if he did know
it was not likely that he would knowingly keep incriminating
evidence in his place.
The result of our inquiries showed that Lee Zang Shu
was in the wrong, and the Dean would have prosecuted him, but
decided that it might reflect on the reputation of the college
to have its name through the Court and press under such
circumstances, and that it probably would not be approved of
by the committee and government of the school who are people
of high standing and not likely to tolerate communism.
The reason they took Lee Zang Shu back to the school
was apparently with a view to getting him to disclose the names
of those responsible for the plot against the Dean and the
others concerned.
Officer i/c Special Branch.
（批：a few days have elapsed since this report makes the situation clear 30/12/29）

檔案編號
（刑事偵緝處）辦公室備忘錄
第2頁

校長房間看到的文獻是由某些學生放置的，但他拒絕透露這些人的姓名。張將軍和校長聽取了這一陳述，當他們返回學院後，正如李尚儒所言，發現了那包文獻，並於次日即12月14日將其帶至本處辦公室，無疑認為此舉妥當。顯然，李尚儒參與了針對校長的陰謀，校長告知我們，他最近注意到李尚儒的行蹤有些奇怪，該生總是早晨最早到校，晚上最後離開，這很不尋常，使其有機會進入與其正當事務無關的房間，並可能親自將文獻放置在後來被發現的地方，儘管校長並未完全責怪他。
除非消息從戈登路捕房或法院洩露，否則校長不可能知曉我們已受理此案或已簽發搜查令；即便他知曉，也不太可能故意在其住處保留定罪證據。
我們的調查結果顯示李尚儒理虧，校長本欲起訴他，但認為在此情況下讓學校名稱通過法庭和媒體曝光可能會損害學校聲譽，且學校委員會和政府成員均為德高望重之士，不太可能容忍共產主義，因此大概不會贊成此舉。
他們將李尚儒帶回學校的原因，顯然是為了讓他供出策劃針對校長及其他相關人員陰謀的主謀姓名。
特別支部主管警官。
（批註：自本報告以來已過去數日，情況已明朗 1929年12月30日）

To Chinese Section.

Please make a further report explaining the
following points:-
I) What reasons did the Dean, Lee Fung Ding (李鳳亭),
give for bringing the literature to Headquarters
instead of taking it to a Police station?
2) Would it be possible that information reached him
that the report made at Gordon Road Station had been
sent to you to be dealt with or that a search warrant
had been issued on your application?
3) Apart from statements made by parties directly
interested, what evidence is there that students,
who had a grudge against Lee Fung Ding (李鳳亭),
placed reactionary literature in his quarters?
4) If there is no absolute proof of the falsity of the
accusation against Lee Fung Ding, why was the name of
the informer, Lee Zang Shu (李長書), disclosed to
him in view of the necessity for protecting people
who give information and the dangers to which persons
informing on Communists are exposed?
5) If there is absolute proof that Lee Zang Shu is
in the wrong, would it not be in the public interest
to prosecute him in view of the very serious charge he
has made against Dean Lee Fung Ding (李鳳亭), and
summon Lee to appear in Court as a witness?
6) How is it that Lee Fung Ding was willing to take
back to his college a student who had tried to injure
him in such a serious way?

（批：Suggest send copy to Mr. Jear.）

A. C. (Pol.)

（刑事偵緝處）辦公室備忘錄
（印章：檔案編號 D. 828 / 刑事偵緝處檔案室 / 特別市警察 / 1952年12月）

致華探股。

請提交進一步報告，解釋以下幾點：
1) 校長李鳳亭將文獻帶至總部而非送往警察局的原因是什麼？
2) 是否有可能他獲悉在戈登路捕房作出的報告已轉交你處處理，或已根據你的申請簽發了搜查令？
3) 除直接利害關係人的陳述外，有何證據表明對李鳳亭懷恨在心的學生將反動文獻放置在其住所？
4) 如果沒有絕對證據證明對李鳳亭的指控屬虛假，鑑於保護線人的必要性以及舉報共產黨人所面臨的危險，為何要向李鳳亭披露舉報人李長書的姓名？
5) 如果有絕對證據證明李長書有錯，鑑於他對李鳳亭校長提出了非常嚴重的指控，為了公共利益，難道不應起訴他並傳喚李出庭作證嗎？
6) 李鳳亭為何願意接回一名曾以如此嚴重方式試圖傷害他的學生？

（批註：建議抄送一份給 Jear 先生。）

A. C. (警務)

December 27th, 1929.

Alleged Communists in Sing Ming (新民)
College, No.80 Connaught Road.

Sir,
Reference to the attached further investigation
has disclosed the fact that the reports made by Lee Zang Shu
(李尚儒) student in the Sing Ming (新民) College, No.80
Connaught Road, charging the Dean of the College Lee Fung Ding
(李风亭) and certain other students in the college, with
being Communists, are groundless, and were the result of
dissention between two factions among the students over an
attempt by members of one faction to misappropriate some
$20,000 funds of the College which was found out and prevented
by Lee Fung Ding (李风亭). The plans having been thus
frustrated these students, with a view to revenge on Lee
Fung Ding and his assistents, sent a petition to the Lunghwa
Military Headquarters accusing them of being Communists, and
evidently with a view to expediting action they sent the
student Lee Zang 儒 (李尚儒) to make a report to the
Gordon Road Police, and at the same time procured some copies
of reactionary literature which they surreptitiously concealed
in the quarters used by the Dean, Lee Fung Ding (李风亭)
and the others whom they accused, so that it could be found
by us if we raided the place. This literature was found by
Lee Fung Ding who brought it to our office on Dec.24. The
student Lee Zang Shu (李尚儒) was then called up and when
confronted with the Dean, Lee Fung Ding (李风亭), he denied
stating that the latter, or any of his assistents, were
communists, and he even denied making a report to that effect
to the Gordon Road Police. The Dean, Lee Fung Ding (李风亭),
then informed us that this student Lee Zang Shu had no money
and had been kept in the college free of charge for the past
6 months. He did not wish to prefer any charge against him

關於康納路80號新民學院涉嫌共產黨人一案。

鈞座：
參閱附件，進一步調查揭示事實如下：康納路80號新民學院學生李尚儒舉報該院校長李風亭及校內其他學生為共產黨人，該舉報毫無根據，實乃學生兩派之間紛爭的結果。起因是一派成員試圖侵吞約20,000元校款，被李風亭發現並阻止。由於計劃受挫，這些學生為報復李風亭及其助手，向龍華軍事總部遞交請願書，指控他們是共產黨人；顯然為了加速行動進展，他們派遣學生李尚儒向戈登路捕房舉報，同時獲取了一些反動文獻副本，偷偷藏匿在被指控的校長李風亭及其他人的住所內，以便我們若進行突擊搜查時能夠發現。該文獻由李風亭發現，並於12月24日帶至本處辦公室。隨後傳喚學生李尚儒，當面對質校長李風亭時，他否認曾稱後者或其任何助手為共產黨員，甚至否認曾向戈登路捕房作出此類舉報。校長李風亭隨後告知我們，該學生李尚儒身無分文，過去6個月一直免費留在該校。他不願對其提出虛假指控的訴訟

Report on Activities of Communists

Sir,
Lee Zang Teh (李尚德), Student at the Sing Ming
College (彩民大學), 80 Connaught Road, reported to this
Station that at 9 a.m., this inst., he was approached in
the college by two teachers and four students who request-
ed him to join the ranks of the Communist Party. He fur-
ther states that he saw a quantity of communistic litera-
ture in the teachers' desks this morning.
The names of these communist are Lee Fung Ding (李鳳
庭), Oo Tsu Foo (胡哲敷) (teachers), Sih Sz Ming (薛自明),
Lee S Wei (李思危), Wong Siau Kyui (王學) and Tsu Tuh
Yee (祝德彝) (students). Chief Inspector Robertson was
immediately informed.
One student was arrested for being in possession
of pamphlets at this ████ school on November 27, 1929.
(C.R.A.No.293(G.R.).

關於共產黨活動的報告

鈞座：
康納路80號彩民大學學生李尚德向本捕房報告稱，本月上午9時，他在學院內被兩名教師和四名學生接觸，要求其加入共產黨行列。他進一步聲稱，今天上午他在教師辦公桌內看到了大量共產主義文獻。
這些共產黨人的姓名為：李鳳庭、胡哲敷（教師），薛自明、李思危、王學和祝德彝（學生）。已立即通知羅伯遜總督察。
1929年11月27日，一名學生因在該 ████ 學校持有小冊子而被捕。
